findings.claim: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes are present in the supplied regional enrichment table: soft_mass enrichment_z is positive and significant at landmark_00 (effect_z 0.639, q 1.88e-4, positive_batch_fraction 1.0), landmark_10 (0.395, q 3.72e-4, 1.0), landmark_07 (0.481, q 7.39e-3, 0.857), and landmark_18 (1.205, q 0.0623, 0.714), with enrichment_change_rate_z positive at landmark_02 (1.371, q 0.0939) and landmark_06 (1.077, q 0.0939).

The local_cyy contrast is consistently negative across the observed window: enrichment_z is negative with q<0.05 at landmarks 00, 01, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 12, 13, 16, 17, 18, 19, and positive_batch_fraction is 0.0 at landmarks 00, 01, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 12, 16, 17, 19, indicating a signed directional contrast rather than an absolute geometric descriptor.

The local_cxx contrast is likewise negative and significant (q<0.05) at landmarks 00, 01, 03, 05, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 19 for enrichment_z, and at landmarks 00, 01, 04, 07, 08, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 19 for parent_edge_contrast_rate_z, with positive_batch_fraction 0.0 at landmarks 04, 07, 17, 19.

The local_dy contrast is positive and significant (q<0.05) at landmarks 02, 06, 09, 10, 14, 18 for enrichment_z with positive_batch_fraction 1.0 at landmarks 02, 06, 09, 14, 18, and negative and significant at landmarks 00, 01, 03, 04, 08, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 19, showing a region-dependent signed contrast over the complete observed window.

Temporal enrichment_change_rate_z contrasts are positive and significant (q<0.05) for local_dz at landmarks 01, 04, 08, 19, for local_cyz at landmarks 02, 04, 06, 07, 08, 14, 17, 18, and for local_cxz at landmarks 02, 04, 06, 07, 08, 12, 14, 16, 17, 18, indicating signed change-rate contrasts over the observed window rather than a static absolute descriptor.

The soft_mass enrichment contrast is a selection-enrichment statistic (measure enrichment_z, with enrichment_change_rate_z as its temporal counterpart) computed over the observed selection nodes; it is not an absolute geometric descriptor and does not by itself establish a physical interaction energy or neural-module causation.

Parent-edge contrast-rate soft_mass effects are positive and significant (q<0.05) at landmarks 00, 10, 12, and negative and significant at landmarks 01, 03, 11, 12, 13, 16, 17, 18, 19, so the parent-edge contrast is signed and region-dependent rather than uniformly favorable.

hypotheses.claim: If the observed selection-node soft_mass enrichment contrast is used as a coordinate reward over the complete observed window, the favorable-versus-comparison direction is the positive soft_mass enrichment direction at landmarks 00, 07, 10, 18 and the positive enrichment_change_rate direction at landmarks 02 and 06; this remains a coordinate contrast, not a trajectory velocity force.

limitations: Only regional contrast evidence is supplied in this isolated interface probe; no current study outcome data are available to the design roles.

Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false), so selection, survival, last-record joint-head labels and decoded terminal rescoring cannot be distinguished from the supplied evidence.
The supplied tables are enrichment/contrast statistics over observed selection nodes and the observed window; they are not physical interaction energies and do not establish neural-module causation.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and no temperature edit is proposed or supported by this evidence.
Transformed copies are never production evidence or inputs to compilation.
